description: Print-on-demand fulfillment: shipping rates, orders and tracking
name: Printful

extensions.name: Printful
extensions.description: Live Printful shipping rates for print-on-demand items, with a configurable flat-rate fallback.

images.title: Paid orders to Printful, tracking back
images.description: Paid orders go to Printful automatically, and each Printful shipment comes back to the Swell order with its tracking number.

images.title: Live Printful rates at checkout
images.description: Shoppers see Printful shipping rates for their address next to your own services, with an optional fallback rate for slow quotes.

images.title: Try it before it costs anything
images.description: Live fulfillment starts off, so paid orders reach Printful as unconfirmed drafts. Nothing is printed or charged until you switch it on.

images.title: Problems show up where you work
images.description: Rejected orders are flagged on the Swell order and emailed to your admins, and retry when you set the fulfillment job back to Pending.
